subject: ground pangolin
creator: Shedron Mukhumo
alt: A ground pangolin is tightly curled on dry soil among short grass and stems. Its broad tail wraps over the concealed head and ventral body; scales and their overlapping edges are clear. No predator, ants or feeding are visible.
detail: The grass movement, hunger, imagined stomach sounds, tightening, partial opening and scent of the previous foraging patch are fictional. The exact image earns defensive enclosure. It does not establish why this real animal curled or whether it made any sound. Ordinary imagined mammalian digestive sounds are not presented as a documented species-specific behavior. No claim that she cannot breathe while curled.

subject: lesser Egyptian jerboa
creator: Kristof Zyskowski and Yulia Bereshpolova (Dipodidae: Jaculus jaculus (Lesser Egyptian Jerboa))
alt: A lesser Egyptian jerboa stands on pale cracked ground at night. A long narrow shadow extends behind it to the left, while a shorter upright ear-topped shadow lies beyond its head. Long hind feet, tail tuft and pale underside are visible.
detail: The photograph visibly supplies two shadows and artificial illumination. Sorrel interpreting them as threatening bodies, crouching, waiting for a sustained light to move and then leaping are fictional temporal development. The flash does not document a continuous light beam or prove a particular fear response. No real predator or companion is asserted; no moon is invented as the source of incompatible lighting.
